# ArcKit FDE

> ArcKit FDE has moved to https://arckit.org/fde/

ArcKit Forward Deploy Engineering is now part of arckit.org. Its pages:

- [ArcKit FDE](https://arckit.org/fde/): the service, the bootstrap sprint and its pricing.
- [Sample bootstrap pack](https://arckit.org/fde/samples/governance-pack.html): fictional sample outputs for principles, requirements, risk and stakeholders.
- [ArcKit architects](https://arckit.org/fde/architects.html): architects who deliver ArcKit engagements, and how to join the network.

ArcKit's own llms.txt, which describes the service under "Expert help", is at https://arckit.org/llms.txt.
